newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh seeks 5.92 mln barrels of oil products.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh seeks 5.92 mln barrels of oil products.

text.p: State-owned Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation (BPC) has floated a tender for importing 5.92 million barrels of petroleum products from January-June, 1997 shipments, BPC officials said on Monday.
Included among the products BPC is seeking are superior kerosene oil, motor spirit, aviation turbine fuel and high speed diesel, they said, but gave no details.
The offers for bidding will be received by BPC until 0600 GMT on December 3.
